items.title: Samsung Showcases P9 and P7 SSDs Featuring USB4 at Gamescom 2026
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics a global leader in advanced memory technology, today unveiled the P9 and P7, its next-generation portable solid-state drives (SSDs) featuring USB4 connectivity.
